# Carlos Raymond — Science Journal

> Independent research and essays in physics, mathematics, chemistry, biology and
> technology by Carlos Raymond, a Brazilian student researcher and national astronomy
> olympiad champion. Every article is written to academic standards with verifiable
> references.

## About the author

Carlos Raymond (Carlos Eduardo Raymond de Paula Ramos) is a student researcher based in
Curitiba, Brazil. National champion of the Brazilian Astronomy Olympiad and finalist in
other science olympiads. He writes in English about exact sciences and technology.

- Full profile: https://carlosraymond.com/about/
- Contact and corrections: via the site

## Sections

- Physics (including astronomy): https://carlosraymond.com/physics/
- Mathematics: https://carlosraymond.com/mathematics/
- Chemistry: https://carlosraymond.com/chemistry/
- Biology: https://carlosraymond.com/biology/
- Technology: https://carlosraymond.com/technology/

- Sitemap: https://carlosraymond.com/sitemap.xml

## Editorial policy

Articles are original work by Carlos Raymond. Scientific claims are supported by
references to published literature. Corrections are welcome and published openly.
Content may be cited with attribution to Carlos Raymond, carlosraymond.com.
